snippet.title: What Do We Say Before We Sleep? 🌙 Bedtime Dua for Kids | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Yawn! It's bedtime. What do we say before we sleep?

Our beloved Prophet Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) would say before sleeping:
🌙 "Bismika Allahumma amootu wa ahya" (With Your name, O Allah, I die and I live: sleep is like a little death, and waking up is like living again)

And when he woke up:
☀️ "Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana, wa ilaihin-nushur" (All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after making us sleep, and to Him we return). In this Short we start little ones with "Alhamdu lillah".

Who will your little one say it with tonight?

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6324: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:6324

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: muhammadarhamamin77800 on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-198164/)

We never show any Prophet or Companion. All characters are faceless.
For ages 3 to 9 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at
